title: Choose a message
summary: Swift: Choose a message. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: if checks a Boolean rule, which is either true or false. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.

blocks.title: Choose a message
blocks.code:
let score = 8
if score >= 5 { print("Pass") } else { print("Try again") }

blocks.text: The comparison is true because 8 is at least 5. The first print runs.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Swift if needs a Boolean; a bare number is not a condition.
